name: @nodeve/schema
description: Central schema source for describing things, authored as a relational LinkML model and projected for storage, validation, and code.

scripts.project: node src/cli.ts catalog data gen/catalog.json --schema-rows && node bin/data2schema.ts && pnpm project:types && pnpm project:jsonschema && pnpm project:ddl && pnpm project:ddl:pg
scripts.project:types: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml gen-typescript nodeve.yaml > ../gen/schema.ts
scripts.project:jsonschema: cd gen && uvx --from linkml gen-json-schema -t Catalog --closed nodeve-projected.yaml > catalog.schema.json && node ../bin/stencil-link.ts && node ../bin/camel-schema.ts
scripts.project:ddl: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml python ../bin/ddl.py sqlite > ../gen/nodeve.sqlite.sql
scripts.project:ddl:pg: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml python ../bin/ddl.py postgresql > ../gen/nodeve.postgres.sql
scripts.build: pnpm fix && pnpm project && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: pnpm check:format && pnpm check:prefixes && pnpm check:meta && pnpm project && pnpm check:catalog && pnpm check:db && pnpm check:db:pg && pnpm typecheck
